name: Omarchy YouTube Music
author: OmarchyYouTubeMusic
description: YouTube Music in Omarchy with a top bar widget and a full terminal player that uses your YouTube account for the homepage, recommendations, and library.

barWidget.description: YouTube Music in Omarchy with a top bar widget and a full terminal player that uses your YouTube account for the homepage, recommendations, and library.

schema.label: Show track title in bar
schema.description: Show the current song title in the bar.

schema.label: Show artist name in bar
schema.description: Show the current artist name in the bar.

schema.label: Show paused track in bar
schema.description: When off, the bar collapses to the YouTube Music icon while paused.

schema.label: Scroll long bar text
schema.description: Softly scroll bar text that does not fit.

schema.label: Maximum bar text width
schema.description: Width from 160 to 560 px. Use 0 for unlimited.

schema.label: Playback quality
schema.description: Audio format cap passed to yt-dlp. Takes effect the next time the player starts.

schema.label: Sleep idle player
schema.description: Minutes after playback fully stops before the background player exits. Use 0 to keep it running.

schema.label: Terminal command for the TUI
schema.description: Command that opens a terminal running a program, for example "kitty" (kitty CMD), "foot" (foot -e CMD), or "xdg-terminal-exec". Empty picks the Omarchy default terminal.
